notes.title: Story 2 Released!
notes.content:
Hi there! Story 2 is now out for everyone :).

You might be confused as to why it took so long, well here's a little explanation.


I finished Story 2 a while back, but since my original plan was to raise the price 1 dollar with each story released I could not release it yet. As Steam didn't allow any price change up to 30 days prior to the summer sales.


However, after this waiting and after playing story 2 multiple times, I feel like the game is at a sweet spot in price right now. Raising it would only turn people off. Story 2 is a small addition compared to the main 1st story but one with a different feel to it. More action oriented and more personality driven.


You can expect something wildly different again for Story 3. As I want to keep things fresh with each release.



So yeah. Go on and get some spooks in yah!

notes.title: The release and future of Mono.
notes.content:
Why hello, thanks for stopping by, you see I've made a decision regarding Mono and how it will be handled post release.

The game will consist of 3 stories, at launch the first story titled "I Want To Get Out" will be available to play and is the story you saw in the demo, completed. 

The game will launch for 3,99 dollars with the first story, if you buy it at that price you will get all the other stories free as the game updates.


With each additional story added to the game the initial purchase price will increase by 1 dollar, with the final price being 5,99. 


Again if you bought it for the initial 3,99 you will still get all the stories down the line.
